courses.title: Robotics with Embedded 'C'
courses.shortDescription: Build, program, and innovate with industry-leading microcontrollers and component-based robotics.
courses.description: Learn to design, build, and program autonomous robots using Embedded C. Covers sensors, actuators, control systems, and real-world projects starting from component level.

courses.title: Artificial Intelligence (AI) with Python
courses.shortDescription: Explore the frontiers of Artificial Intelligence, Computer Vision, and smart automation using Python.
courses.description: A comprehensive journey from Python programming basics to building intelligent agents, image classifiers, and interactive AI models.

courses.title: Internet of Things (IoT) with Embedded 'C'
courses.shortDescription: Connect physical devices to the cloud and build real-time smart home & telemetry systems.
courses.description: Hands-on engineering with ESP32/ESP8266 Wi-Fi microcontrollers, cloud dashboards, REST APIs, and MQTT sensor telemetry.

courses.title: Machine Learning (ML) with Python
courses.shortDescription: Train predictive algorithms and analyze data patterns using Scikit-learn and Python.
courses.description: Dive deep into supervised and unsupervised learning algorithms, feature engineering, and deploying predictive ML models.

courses.title: Mechatronics
courses.shortDescription: Master CAD modeling, gear mechanisms, and electromechanical prototyping.
courses.description: Students learn how hardware structure, gears, linkages, and electronic actuators harmonize in industrial automation and robotic arms.

courses.title: UAV (Drones)
courses.shortDescription: Understand aerodynamics, flight controllers, telemetry, and drone assembly.
courses.description: Learn how quadcopters work, calculate thrust-to-weight ratios, calibrate flight controllers, and execute autonomous waypoint navigation.

courses.title: Augmented Reality / Virtual Reality
courses.shortDescription: Immerse in interactive 3D spatial computing, virtual simulations, and holographic AR environments.
courses.description: Explore the exciting domain of Augmented and Virtual Reality. Students learn 3D modeling, spatial environments, interactive simulations, and building AR/VR apps using industry-standard game engines and sensors.

courses.title: Database & Programming Languages
courses.shortDescription: Master computational logic, relational database schemas, SQL queries, and robust programming principles.
courses.description: Build a strong foundation in core computer science, relational databases, data structures, and practical coding. Students learn SQL query design, database normalization, and programming logic to build data-driven applications.

courses.title: Deep Learning (DL) with Python
courses.shortDescription: Construct artificial neural networks, convolutional vision architectures, and deep predictive models.
courses.description: Delve into neural networks, backpropagation, convolutional networks (CNNs), and recurrent architectures. Learn how to train deep learning models using Python and PyTorch/TensorFlow for computer vision and speech recognition.
highlights: Model Training, Overfitting Prevention & Loss Curves

courses.title: Game Design (Android/IOS)
courses.shortDescription: Design, animate, and deploy thrilling 2D/3D mobile games with physics engines and touch controls.
courses.description: Learn game development from initial storyboarding to physics simulation, character animation, and cross-platform publishing on Android and iOS. Students build playable games with engaging mechanics.
highlights: Level Design, Score Systems & Game States

courses.title: Android Development (SWIFT UI, FLUTTER, IOS)
courses.shortDescription: Engineer modern, responsive native and cross-platform mobile apps with Flutter, SwiftUI, and Android SDK.
courses.description: Comprehensive mobile app engineering across Android and iOS platforms. Students master user interface design with SwiftUI and Flutter, state management, API integration, and app publishing.

courses.title: Web Development (HTML/CSS/JS)
courses.shortDescription: Craft modern, responsive, interactive websites from scratch using semantic HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
courses.description: Master the foundations of the World Wide Web. Learn semantic HTML5 structure, modern responsive CSS layouts (Flexbox/Grid), and interactive JavaScript programming to build dynamic web applications.
highlights: CSS3 Responsive Layouts, Flexbox & Grid Systems
Async Programming & Fetching Live Web APIs

courses.title: 3D Printing
courses.shortDescription: Transform digital CAD models into physical reality using additive manufacturing and 3D printers.
courses.description: Learn additive manufacturing, slicing software, filament selection, and rapid prototyping. Students design 3D parts in CAD and operate 3D printers to fabricate custom robotic brackets, gears, and enclosures.
highlights: Slicing Software, Layer Heights & Infill Density
Filament Materials: PLA, ABS, PETG & Properties

services.title: Workshops
services.shortDescription: Hands-on technology workshops introducing electronics, robotics, and coding to schools and colleges.
services.description: The main agenda of any workshop is to introduce a new skill or tech to the students and make them fascinated, drive them towards having a long journey in prospering the skill. In this short journey students will get introduced to may electronic component and way to comand them with basic coding skills. This introduction will help them to explore their creative thoughts.
benefits: Support in all the business days/hours.

services.title: Tech Labs (Prayogshala)
services.shortDescription: Custom-designed and installed industry-grade innovation tech labs for schools.
services.description: We custom design and setup industry-grade tech labs where students learn and become creative with the skills gained in the classroom. Equipped with every hardware component starting from screws to advanced microcontrollers and sensors. We also provide aesthetic maker materials to encourage students to create attractive, robust prototypes.

services.title: Tech Tours (Anveshana)
services.shortDescription: Structured immersion tours to IITs, NITs, and top university tech & incubation centers.
services.description: Anveshana is a structured tech tour mainly focused on helping students broaden their knowledge of building industry-standard technologies. We plan tours to National level institutions and Universities (mainly IITs, NITs, and top research institutions), introducing students to advanced tech labs, innovative prototypes, and entrepreneurship clubs.
benefits: Exclusive Access to IIT & NIT Labs
Guided Educational Mentorship throughout the tour
Certificate of Participation & Technical Tour Dossier

services.title: Boot Camps
services.shortDescription: Intensive term/semester journeys in electronics, mechanics, and programming.
services.description: As a part of boot camps Students will have a short journey for a term or a semester learning all the required basics of the electronics and coding enough to start making their own creative stuff. In this journey students will start socializing themselves as the best way to learn more in less time is to team up with the peers. This way they enjoy the learning process.
benefits: Support in all the business days/hours.

services.title: Year End Programs
services.shortDescription: Full academic year iterative journey integrating curriculum with science & math.
services.description: As part of Year End programs, students have an iterative journey with electronics and coding, providing deep knowledge of each robot/project. Students connect extensive maths and science principles practically with what they build.
benefits: Books & E-Material for every enrolled student

services.title: Online Live Trainings
services.shortDescription: Live interactive robotics & coding lessons delivered right to students' homes.
services.description: Online Live Trainings offer structured remote robotics and STEM education directly to students' homes. Led by experienced and certified instructors, students build critical thinking, coding fluency, and engineering confidence through interactive lessons, virtual simulators, and physical hardware kits.
benefits: Support in all the business days/hours.

services.title: Teacher Training Programs
services.shortDescription: Equipping school educators with hands-on tech stacks, maker tools, and pedagogy.
services.description: One or two teachers from partner schools are trained prior to the academic year. These trained teachers confidently teach students throughout the academic year for the enrolled program.
services.duration: 8 weeks - 14 weeks (1 - 1.5 hours each business day)

services.title: Inter / Intra School Competitions
services.shortDescription: Fast-paced robotics leagues, arena challenges, and tech hackathons.
services.description: Helps children drive themselves in a fast-paced competitive environment matching given problem statements within time limits. Includes making different robots, robo-soccer, obstacle courses, and tech quizzes.

subServices.title: Hands-on Robotics Boot Camp Workshop
subServices.description: 2-day immersive workshop introducing students to motors, sensors, and chassis assembly.
subServices.detailedOverview: In this workshop, students work in small teams to assemble their very first robot from modular components. They understand how battery power, gearboxes, and switches work together before progressing into programming.

subServices.title: Arduino & Microcontroller Workshop
subServices.description: Comprehensive introduction to digital I/O, PWM, and C-based logic on Arduino boards.
subServices.detailedOverview: Students learn how code commands physical components. We cover reading analog inputs, writing digital outputs, and building responsive prototypes like automated streetlights and buzzer alarms.
modules: C++ Syntax & Logic on Arduino IDE

subServices.title: AI & Computer Vision Essentials
subServices.description: Interactive session introducing facial detection, object tracking, and camera feeds.
subServices.detailedOverview: Designed for young curious minds to see AI in action. Using intuitive Python libraries and block tools, students write code to detect faces, recognize hand gestures, and trigger robotic actions.

subServices.title: Component-Based Robotics Lab
subServices.description: A complete innovation lab setup with microcontrollers, breadboards, chassis, and electronics.
subServices.detailedOverview: We install dedicated workstations equipped with component organizers, DC power supplies, multimeters, and over 150+ varieties of electronic parts. This transforms ordinary classrooms into active R&D centers.

subServices.title: Advanced IoT & Smart Systems Lab
subServices.description: Cloud-connected lab bench with Wi-Fi microcontrollers and telemetry display modules.
subServices.detailedOverview: Equips older students to build IoT stations that push environmental data, air quality stats, and telemetry to cloud dashboards, giving them real exposure to smart-city technologies.

subServices.title: Makerspace & Prototyping Station
subServices.description: Creative fabrication station featuring 3D printers, foam cutters, and aesthetic modeling supplies.
subServices.detailedOverview: Allows students to give physical shape to their creative ideas. From lightweight aerodynamic shells to gear linkages, this station fosters mechanical engineering intuition.
modules: Foam Cutters, Safety Shears & Glue Guns

subServices.title: IIT & National University Immersion
subServices.description: Guided technical visits to IIT Hyderabad and premier university research labs.
subServices.detailedOverview: Students walk through national research labs, witness advanced industrial robots, supercomputing clusters, and interact directly with professors and doctoral scholars.

subServices.title: Incubation & Startup Hub Visit
subServices.description: Exposure to deep-tech hardware startups, patent labs, and prototype testing centers.
subServices.detailedOverview: Inspires young minds to see how school projects grow into commercial innovations. Students tour incubator floors, meet startup founders, and see patents being engineered.

subServices.title: Semester Robotics Foundation
subServices.description: 12-week structured semester track covering circuit theory, logic gates, and autonomous navigation.
subServices.detailedOverview: A weekly intensive sprint where students build a complete functional robot from scratch, culminating in a semester exhibition for parents and faculty.

subServices.title: School Annual Curriculum Program
subServices.description: Full 10-month integration into the school timetable from Grade 3 through Grade 10.
subServices.detailedOverview: Seamlessly aligns with CBSE/ICSE science and mathematics syllabus. Each student receives individual books, hardware components, and weekly lab instruction from certified mentors.

subServices.title: Tech Teaching Methodologies & Maker Pedagogy
subServices.description: Intensive 8-14 week training empowering school teachers to run hands-on STEM classes.
subServices.detailedOverview: Focuses on pedagogical confidence: how to guide students through open-ended debugging, safety in maker labs, and grading experiential STEM projects.

settings.aboutStory:
The pace of technical development in the modern world is accelerating more quickly than before. Adaptation and the acquisition of new competencies and skills are crucial in this continuously changing world. All citizens—young and old—are impacted by the advancement of digital technology and the digitalization of society.

Our future generation is now in need to learn about these machines to be future ready. We at Edueme take extensive care of providing Work-Oriented learning opportunities to our students to make them ready for the 2nd half of the 21st century.

Our team includes research scientists, innovators, and Physicists who have extensive knowledge and rich experience in the areas of Robotics, Mechanical Design, Machine Learning, and Artificial Intelligence. We are the first in India to introduce component-based robotics from 3rd standard.
settings.mission: To provide high-quality, practical, and industry-focused education in emerging technologies, turning curious students into capable 21st-century inventors and engineers.
